candidates.title: Democrat wins Alaska governor’s seat for first time in nearly 30 years
candidates.excerpt: Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins’ victory means Democrats will now hold 30 US governorships after midterm blowout Democrats have captured Alaska’s governor’s seat for the first time in nearly three decades, marking another major victory for their party in a midterm election period that has dramatically shifted political power across the US. Former Alaska state legislator Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins defeated three Republican opponents, including a candidate backed by Donald Trump, becoming the first Democrat elected governor of Alaska since 1998.…

candidates.excerpt: Republican House speaker not running for re-election contrasts sharply with president who avoids accountability In his first interview since the midterm elections, the US House speaker, Mike Johnson, said that the Republican party’s crushing losses during the 3 November elections prompted his decision to step away from party leadership. “Leaders have to take responsibility when things go wrong,” Johnson said on Fox News on Saturday.…

candidates.title: Midterm voters ended the long-running GOP dominance in state legislatures
candidates.excerpt: In several states, Democrats took control of legislatures that had been divided and they weakened GOP dominance in others. Issues on the agenda: More access to health care, new limits on school vouchers. (Image credit: Sarah Kallis)
